# Projection

Source: [`Kernel/Projection.wl`](../../Kernel/Projection.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#projection-kernelprojectionwl--projectonmonomials)

ProjectOnMonomials: for every classified monomial (I nu)^m (p^2)^n of d\_s Gamma2\_ab(nu, p), apply (d/d(I nu))^m / m!  and the (p^2)^n coefficient (direction average of the s^(2n) Taylor coefficient of p = s e, any n; design/MOMENTUMPROJECTION.md M1), at nu = 0, p = 0 (pipeline 1: external variables set to zero), to the loop integrand; the same operator applied to Gamma\_k (regulator off) is asserted to give its coefficient (LHS check). Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Projection".

## Symbols

### `ProjectOnMonomials`

`ProjectOnMonomials[loops, symmetries]` returns the "Projection" stage: one w-integrand per classified monomial (all classes except "Structure"), at nu = p = 0, as a function of w and q^2 = LoopMomentumSquared.

### `LoopMomentumSquared`

LoopMomentumSquared is the symbol for q^2 in projected integrands and in the flow equations.

### `ShowIntegrand`

`ShowIntegrand[projected, coefficient]` or `ShowIntegrand[projected, {a, b}, {m, n}]` prints the w-integrand of a monomial.
